title: lazycast config.yaml
description:
Global (~/.config/lazycast/config.yaml) or project (.lazycast/config.yaml) settings: which features are enabled and their per-feature settings. A project's enabled set adds to the global one; its settings override the global ones key by key. Keep in sync with internal/config/features_config.go. Reference from a YAML file with:
  # yaml-language-server: $schema=../schema/lazycast-config.schema.json

default_profile.description: Preselected value for the profile param on every maven: command.
